hook.text: Charlie Munger says solve any problem by inverting it. Instead of asking how to succeed.

buildup.text: Inversion means approaching a goal by thinking backward.

discovery.text: Carl Jacobi, the mathematician, famously said invert, always invert.

twist.text: People obsess over best practices but ignore worst practices.

climax.text: For any goal, write down every way to fail at it. Then systematically remove those failure modes.

punchline.text: List how to fail. Then avoid every item.

quiz.question: Who is famous for saying 'invert, always invert'?
